standards.text: Learners demonstrate an understanding of fundamental concepts, theories, and function of management including the role of business within their environments and the impact of external factors on organizational success for the promotion of inclusive practices and gender equality.
The learners design an organizational structure with specified roles and responsibilities.

Learners demonstrate understanding of control concepts and techniques and their relationship to management functions among small and medium enterprises while valuing social responsibility and sustainable business practices.
The learners prepare any advocacy campaign material for an existing business, promoting ethical business practices integrating United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
